about_the_game:
"What’s the scariest part of any campfire story? The moment you realize it might just be true."
«Campfire Stories: The Giant of Green Peaks» is a short cinematic horror experience where you play as a hiker kidnapped in the heart of the Pacific Northwest wilderness. The game combines the suspense of «Firewatch» and the meditative dread of «Dear Esther». No jumpscares — just pure dread of being stalked by the unseen pursuer as you navigate forest landscapes in hopes to find a way out. 

Features:

  • Immersive Atmosphere: A love letter to classic horror stories — short, intense, and unforgettable. Carefully crafted environment, cinematic landscapes and hyper-realistic forest sounds make you experience the horrors of a classic campfire story in first person.

  • Environmental Storytelling: The tension builds with every rustle of leaves, every distant growl — because in Green Peaks, every sound could be the last thing you hear.

  • Psychological Horror: Escape the misty forest and try to survive the encounter with a famous cryptid. There is no fighting back the monster that lives deep in the woods — your only option is to run and hide.

Out Summer 2025 | PC (Steam)
